name: Anchor
description: Upstream-parity anchor primitives (Anchor, ContextAnchor, LinkedAnchor) and overlay anchor registry/scope for position-tracked overlays.

use: you need overlays that track an anchor widget's live position.
you want linked anchors resolved through a scoped registry.
avoid: a one-off popover without position tracking (use `popover`).

accessibility: Anchors are layout-only and expose no semantics of their own.
do: Scope repeated regions with `OverlayAnchorScope` so keys stay local.
dont: Reuse the same anchor key across sibling scopes bound to one registry.
